description: This Java class 'ModifyFeaturesStrategy' implements a command handling strategy for modifying features of a 'Thing' in a persistence layer of a Ditto-based application. It performs size validation, generates appropriate events ('FeaturesModified' or 'FeaturesCreated'), and manages headers and entity tags.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for handling 'ModifyFeatures' commands, including validation, event creation, and header/entity tag management.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the modify or create logic for features, validating size and returning appropriate event results.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Constructs a result with a 'FeaturesModified' event when features are updated.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Constructs a result with a 'FeaturesCreated' event when features are newly created.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag from the previous state of the 'Thing' if it exists.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates a new entity tag based on the current features.
